This has be true for a while and it doesn’t feel right. On X11 things are better
and application do not run all the time as long as there is no event (mouse, key
or compositor asking for repaint). Is there any alternative to make efficient
GUI? I am building one because for the longest time Qt/GTK/WxWidget had so many
issues and are not meant to directly draw with OpenGL when you need it.
